text:
Alicia: weird bug during onboarding smoke tests: node SDK happily creates routes with huge routeId strings by truncating them to 64 chars, but the REST API rejects long names with 400. this causes collisions in staging.

Jamie: wow. can you paste the minimal repro and which sdk version?

Alicia: repro (node 18, sdk@2.5.0):

```js
const longId = 'route-' + 'x'.repeat(120);
await client.routes.create({ routeId: longId, config: { /* ... */ } });
// -> { id: 'route-' + 'x'.repeat(64), ok: true }
```

Alicia: curl to the same endpoint: 

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"routeId":"'"$longId"'","config":{}}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
# {"error":"routeId too long: max 64 chars"}
```

Noor: that mismatch is dangerous. truncating silently changes identity. did the SDK intentionally normalize?

Alicia: SDK debug shows client layer doing a `safeId = id.slice(0,64)` and returning success. no warning or metadata returned.

Jamie: hmm, I remember a historical shim where client trimmed ids to match older backend limits, but we shouldn't mutate client input without warning. will open a patch to throw on too-long ids and add a clear error.

Noor: sampleapp onboarding expects create to fail when route is invalid so it can surface a user error. with truncation we get an unexpected successful create that later collides with real routes. we need a hotfix in sampleapp too.

Alicia: working around by validating length locally in sampleapp for now. pushed branch onboarding/validate-routeid.

Jamie: I'll file RED-5012 and draft PR to change SDK behavior: 1) validate and throw for invalid params (match server validation), 2) include a verbose debug flag that returns the server/raw request/response for edge debugging, 3) add a deprecation note if anyone relied on truncation. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1133 (draft).

Noor: good. add unit tests that assert SDK throws for >64 char routeId and an integration test that simulates the server 400 to ensure parity. also audit any other client-side normalizations.

DevX-Bot: Created issue RED-5012: "SDK: stop silent truncation of routeId; surface validation errors". Assigned to @Jamie. Priority: P1.

Jamie: plan: release 2.5.1 with validation and migration note. sampleapp patch to be rolled to staging as a hotfix. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Alicia: thanks. also if we can add an invariant check in sampleapp e2e so this doesn't slip back in, that'd be great. :thumbsup:
